text:
rui: FYI ran a smoke bring-up for nebula-mini with sparse-hash kvcache + q5-compact and seeing bracket mirroring / boundary drift in mixed CJK + RTL pairs. short repro below.

ana: can you paste the tiny sample + git info?

rui: commit 9b2f7ac (kvcache:sparse-hash-opt), kernel v5.3.0, quant q5-compact. quick delta summary.

omar: numbers? is this a single sample fluke or systemic?

rui: paste: 

```
# baseline (main, flat cache, q8)
BLEU: 31.2
input: "\u6211\u5011\u53去\u623f\u9593 (\u05e9\u05dc\u05bc\u05d5\u05dd)."
output: "We went to the room (in the city)."

# experiment (sparse-hash kvcache + q5)
BLEU: 20.8
input: "\u6211\u5011\u53去\u623f\u9593 (\u05e9\u05dc\u05bc\u05d5\u05dd)."
output: "We went to the room )in the city( ."

# notes: parentheses flipped / detached, mirrored punctuation moves next to hebrew fragment, spacing around CJK collapsed; detok pairing mismatch
```

selina: whoa that's harsh. sounds like detok pairing or parity of unicode directionality marks in the kvcache keys.

rui: repro command I used:

```
python run_eval.py --model nebula-mini --kernel v5.3.0 --quant q5-compact --cache sparse-hash --input tests/mixed_cjk_rtl.short --metrics bleu,exact_match --save-outputs /tmp/nebula_regress
```

ci-bot: upload complete -> gs://redwood-evals/bugs/6319991234/ (120 examples, sample detok script).

omar: quick triage: inspected token ids and kv keys. sparse-hash uses a truncated context fingerprint -> collision probability up slightly. when collision + quant rounding change -> candidate logits reorder -> decoder chooses different bracket attachment. interaction looks multiplicative.

infra-bot: cluster-run: canary (2 x p4d) scheduled for A/B.

selina: can we separate factors? run A: sparse-hash + q8, B: flat kvcache + q5, C: both. I'll spin those now.

omar: ran locally earlier: A (sparse-hash, q8) BLEU=29.1, B (flat cache, q5) BLEU=25.3, C (both) BLEU=20.6. consistent with interaction.

selina: thanks. immediate mitigation idea: add directional context bits into the kvcache fingerprint (cheap) + short-term fallback to disable sparse-hash for mixed-orientation samples.

rui: agreed. also add a detok-preservation assert to onboarding smoke (ensure bracket pairs preserved and punctuation remains attached to expected script).

omar: long-term: consider canonicalizing mirrored pairs in cache key generation (mirror-normal form) and add a fuzz test that mixes ZWJ / RLM / LRM with punctuation.

selina: opened issue R-INF-2201 with logs and repro archive. tagged @eng-runtime and @quant-team.

ci-bot: job A (sparse-hash q8) -> BLEU=29.0
ci-bot: job B (flat q5) -> BLEU=25.2
ci-bot: job C (sparse-hash q5) -> BLEU=20.6

rui: thanks. I'll prepare a small canary config to disable sparse-hash when any codepoint from both CJK and strong RTL categories found in prompt. will post PR link.

omar: adding instrumented diffs in detok step (store before/after pairing) will help root cause later. owner: mar.

selina: who can own the smoke test change? ana?

ana: I can take it. will add the 120-sample set to nebula-mini onboarding and to the general multilang regression suite.

infra-bot: canary patch queued -> disable-sparse-hash-mixed-orient (rollout: canary only).

rui: will follow up with an ops note for Dedicated customers who enabled sparse-hash beta. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
